title: Add checkout with address collection and order management

requirements.text: Create an Order data type in the backend that stores customer phone number, delivery address, order items (product IDs and quantities), total price, order timestamp, and caller Principal

quotes: take address and phone no of consumer

acceptanceCriteria: Order type includes phone number field as Text
Order type includes address field as Text
Order type includes array of order items with product references and quantities
Order type includes total price as Float
Order type includes timestamp of order creation
Order type includes customer Principal identifier

requirements.text: Implement a backend function to create and store orders that accepts phone number, address, and cart items, calculates total price, and persists the order with caller Principal and current timestamp

quotes: at the time of checkout take address and phone no

acceptanceCriteria: Function accepts phone number as Text parameter
Function accepts delivery address as Text parameter
Function retrieves cart items for the current caller
Function calculates total order price from cart items
Function creates Order record with all required fields
Function stores order in persistent backend storage
Function clears the customer's cart after successful order creation

requirements.text: Add a backend query function to retrieve all orders for the admin dashboard that returns array of orders with customer details, items, and totals
acceptanceCriteria: Function returns all stored orders as an array
Each order includes phone number and address
Each order includes list of products and quantities
Each order includes total price in Float format
Each order includes timestamp information

requirements.text: Create a checkout page component at /checkout route that displays cart summary, input fields for phone number and delivery address, order total in Indian Rupees, and a 'Place Order' button

quotes: at the time of checkout take address and phone no of consumer

acceptanceCriteria: Page displays complete cart items with quantities and prices
Page includes text input field for phone number with appropriate validation
Page includes textarea for delivery address
Page displays calculated order total in ₹ format
Page includes 'Place Order' button that submits the order
Page maintains Swapan Store design theme with warm Indian spice market colors

requirements.text: Implement checkout flow that calls the backend order creation function with phone number and address, clears the cart on success, and displays confirmation message 'Your order will be delivered today!'

quotes: show the consumer massage that product will be delivered today

acceptanceCriteria: Place Order button triggers backend order creation with phone and address
Success response displays confirmation message 'Your order will be delivered today!'
Cart is emptied after successful order placement
User receives visual feedback (toast or modal) with the delivery confirmation
Error states are handled with appropriate user feedback

requirements.text: Add 'Proceed to Checkout' button to the cart page that navigates to /checkout route when cart has items
acceptanceCriteria: Button appears on cart page below cart items and total
Button is only enabled when cart contains at least one item
Button navigates to /checkout route when clicked
Button styling matches existing Swapan Store theme

requirements.text: Add an Orders section to the admin dashboard that displays all customer orders in a table with columns for order date/time, customer phone number, delivery address, items ordered, and total price in Indian Rupees
acceptanceCriteria: Orders section appears on admin dashboard page
Table displays order timestamp in readable format
Table shows customer phone number for each order
Table shows full delivery address for each order
Table lists all items with quantities for each order
Table displays total order price in ₹ format
Table is styled consistently with existing admin dashboard design
Orders are sorted by most recent first

requirements.text: Create a React Query hook for placing orders that calls the backend order creation function and invalidates cart queries on success
acceptanceCriteria: Hook uses useMutation from React Query
Mutation calls backend order creation function with phone and address parameters
Successful mutation invalidates cart query to reflect empty cart
Hook provides loading, error, and success states to consuming components

requirements.text: Create a React Query hook for fetching all orders in the admin dashboard that calls the backend orders query function
acceptanceCriteria: Hook uses useQuery from React Query
Hook calls backend function to retrieve all orders
Hook provides loading, error, and data states
Query is enabled only when user is authenticated as admin

constraints: Maintain single-actor backend architecture in backend/main.mo
Do not modify immutable frontend paths (hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, hooks/useActor.ts, main.tsx, components/ui)
Use existing cart management system and clear cart after successful order
All prices must be displayed in Indian Rupees (₹) format using existing formatPrice utility
Checkout and order display must follow existing Swapan Store warm Indian spice market design theme
